events.title: The 9th World Chinese Mass Spectrometry Conference (WCMSC)
events.description: Prof. Yao Zhongping, as the Conference Chair, organized the 9th World Chinese Mass Spectrometry Conference at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University from 6 to 8 November 2026.
